what_this_is: Verification targets for the CORRECTED Nature Machine Intelligence manuscript of 2026-11-05. They are compared against values recomputed from the public research data; they are never inputs to any computation and no analysis module reads this file. The corrected manuscript adopted the frozen record's values, so these targets agree with canonical data and the checker should report ZERO discrepancies. The superseded draft's targets and the ten disagreements found against it are kept in reproducibility/manuscript_targets_archive.json.
rounding: The manuscript rounds half away from zero. A computed value is compared after rounding by that rule at the manuscript's reported precision, plus an absolute tolerance for the last displayed digit.

information_transfer.note: These are PAIRED contrasts. The point estimate is (b - c) / n on the paired discordant cells, not a difference of two independent arm rates.

canonical_ladder.denominator_definition: per rung, the complete-case set: cells scoreable in BOTH evidence states for that rung. The denominator therefore differs between rungs.

manuscript_vs_canonical_discrepancies.what_this_is: Disagreements between the CURRENT corrected manuscript and the frozen record. Empty is the expected and required state. The ten found against the superseded draft are archived in manuscript_targets_archive.json, not deleted.

canonical_overrides.what_this_is: Empty. The corrected manuscript prints the canonical value for every assertion, so no assertion needs a canonical substitution.

gpt_5_2.note: GPT-5.2 is a single system, so pooled and system-balanced coincide for every GPT-only contrast. Both are computed and both are asserted, so a change that broke one weighting could not hide behind the other.

relation_to_verdict.display_note: -0.0750335 rounds to -0.08 at two decimals under round-half-away-from-zero; the magnitude exceeds 0.075.

open_weight_raw_vs_fair.note: A PAIRED estimate and a RUNG-MARGINAL descriptive are different quantities on different denominators. They must never be quoted interchangeably.

marginal_relation_to_verdict.why_it_differs: each rung uses its own complete-case set, so the relation rung has 299 cells here and 298 in the paired set

ladder_denominator_definition: Per rung, the jointly scoreable set: cells scoreable in BOTH evidence states at THAT rung. The denominator therefore differs between rungs because scoreability does.

relation_to_verdict_paired_pooled.note: The PAIRED POOLED contrast. The rung-marginal raw difference of +29.4314 pp on 299 cells is a different estimand and must not be substituted for it.

metric_scale_decomposition.what_this_is: A raw detection difference and a balanced-accuracy difference are not on the same scale. Because dBA = (dTPR - dFPR)/2 = J/2, the gap between them has two parts: the false-alarm penalty, which is a real cost, and the metric's own division by two, which carries no empirical content. Reporting the gap as if it were all false alarms overstates the false-alarm effect roughly fourfold.

rung_ordering.what_this_is: Which metrics order the four rungs the same way. Raw sensitivity, balanced accuracy and Youden's J agree; only d-prime reorders, and that reordering rests on two false alarms in 297 cells.

dprime_fragility.note: Three additional false alarms among 297 clean cells -- a one-point change in the false-alarm rate -- restores the ordering the other three metrics give.

transfer_paired_contrasts.what_this_is: Paired contrasts on jointly scoreable cases, clustered by manuscript. The headline relevant-versus-irrelevant comparison combines a benefit and an interference cost, and the two are separated here.

abstention.what_this_is: How the frozen scorer treats UNRESOLVED, and how the headline metrics move under defensible alternatives. The frozen rule is asymmetric: UNRESOLVED is a miss on E0 and a correct rejection on E1.

four_rung_cohort.selection: exp3heldout/design_heldout.py broad_subset(): for each manuscript, group its certified relations by defect family, shuffle the family order with random.Random(SUBSET_SEED+1), take one case per family up to 60//21 = 2 per manuscript, then top up to 60 from the remaining cases under the same seeded shuffle.
four_rung_cohort.inherited_from: the 60-case broad-family replication cohort, reused by the 12-system evidence-profile experiment and then by the four-rung study; it was not redrawn

human_audit_definitions.what_this_is: The targeted scorer audit yields two different item counts under two different questions. Both are correct; they are not interchangeable.

definitions.majority_yes: the majority chose Yes: an explicit scorer false negative
definitions.majority_not_no: the majority chose Yes or Partially: any majority disagreement
definitions.any_yes_or_partial: at least one reviewer chose Yes or Partially

human_audit_definitions.relationship: the 7 majority-Yes items are a strict subset of the 9 majority-disagreement items

annotation_provenance_correction.what_was_wrong: Six scorer-assessment sessions were described as human reviewers. The first author states they were three ChatGPT and three Claude chat sessions. They are not human judgements and not independent validation.
removed_from_primary_analysis: human agreement coefficients (Fleiss' kappa, pairwise agreement)
the four scorer-correction scenarios as empirically supported findings
the verdict that the scorer was validated
annotation_provenance_correction.gold_label_exercise_43_of_47: NOT removed, and NOT asserted. The private research tree records this as a separate exercise with six NAMED participants and per-person raw submissions, whose own analysis distinguishes those responses from a model calibration run. That record conflicts with the instruction to treat it as an AI session. Marked PROVENANCE_UNCONFIRMED pending the author's determination; it is asserted nowhere.
annotation_provenance_correction.retained_as_exploratory: Raw per-item counts remain published unchanged, labelled as exploratory AI-session assessment.

per_system.note: one system shows zero net Youden's J gain
